# Overleaf

> Overleaf is a collaborative online LaTeX editor that streamlines scientific and academic writing with real-time collaboration, AI-powered assistance, and extensive template libraries.

Overleaf serves individual researchers, academic institutions, enterprises, and publishers with cloud-based LaTeX editing capabilities. The platform integrates with reference managers like Mendeley and Zotero, version control systems like GitHub, and cloud storage solutions, making it a comprehensive ecosystem for technical and scientific document creation.

## Key Topics

- LaTeX editor
- Collaborative writing
- Visual editor
- AI Assist & Writefull
- Templates
- Scientific writing
